{{Top|ca|leg}}
The '''Kellis system''' was located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Star system/Legends|system]] was infested with [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Ungo the Hutt}}</ref> Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Ungo the Hutt" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> [[Ungo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] was looking to hire security to escort a shipment of theirs through the system.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual affiliated with one of the two sides in the Cold War sent a companion of theirs to escort the shipment through the Kellis system. The companion fended off a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] attack; grateful, Ungo offered a generous reward to them.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Kellis system was mentioned in the Crew Skill mission "Ungo the Hutt" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the video game.<ref name="TOR" />
